matchedViewportReview.qualification: Original bytes, default conversion, matched inspected image viewport and actual rounded raster. No supplied fonts/resources or animation freeze; these are diagnostic observations, not new reference admissions.

stopIdentityAdmission.qualification: The stop-ID rejection is removed for every original; later admission or pixel gaps remain open. Existing references are unchanged.

afterStopIdentityAdmission.qualification: All source hashes rechecked; stop-ID follow-ups override the initial outcomes for those 13 sources. Other original outcomes and all previously rendered PNG bytes are unchanged. No whole-corpus reference admission.

radialCoordinateInheritance.qualification: Every source hash rechecked. intertwingly.svg is newly exact against three fresh healthy native captures per host; all other outcomes, diagnostics and previously rendered PNG bytes are unchanged. Existing matchedViewportReview and stop-ID follow-ups remain valid. Hosted SVG payload files retained: zero. No whole-corpus reference admission.

gradientLengthResolution.qualification: Every source hash rechecked. All previously rendered PNG bytes and original outcome categories remain unchanged. twitter.svg advances from initial-percentage rejection to the separate URL-paint fallback boundary. Earlier original observations remain valid except that diagnostic update. Hosted SVG payload files retained: zero; no whole-corpus reference admission.

paintReferenceFallback.qualification: Every original hash rechecked. Prior rendered PNGs are byte-identical; other outcome categories and comparisons remain unchanged. Fresh native triples use the same inspected 300x150 logical viewport and reproduce the existing target. No hosted payload retention or whole-corpus reference admission.
